newsitem.title: USA: US mortgage-backeds dip, spreads tighten modestly.
newsitem.headline: US mortgage-backeds dip, spreads tighten modestly.

text.p: U.S. mortgage-backeds continued their losses late in the session on Wednesday, but yield spreads to Treasuries tightened modestly on the day, mortgage experts said.
Traders cited the lack of mortgage banker selling coupled with retail demand for the slight narrowing of spreads between mortgage-backeds and comparable Treasuries.
"Not a lot of mortgage banker selling combined with some customer retail buying ... drove mortgage (spreads) tighter," said one Ginnie trader.
"Ginnie 8.0s and Ginnie 7.0s are going to be great performers on the day," he said.
Prices of Ginnie Mae 30-year 7.5 percent coupons were off 6/32 at 100-15/32 bid, yielding 103 basis points over the 10-year Treasury note.
Comparable Fannie Mae issues were off 5/32 at 100-11/32 and Freddie Mac paper was down 3/32 at 100-17/32.
In Treasury trading, the five-year Treasury note was off 4/32 to yield 6.33 percent, and the 10-year Treasury note was off 10/32, yielding 6.45 percent.
